gaps.sentence: Only when she apologised ___ he agree to meet again.
gaps.explanation: Only when she apologised did he agree — inversion.

gaps.sentence: Reluctant ___ she was to intervene, the referee stopped the match.
gaps.explanation: Fronted adjective + though/as + subject is emphatic concession: Reluctant though she was…

gaps.sentence: Little ___ the villagers suspect that the mine would ever reopen.
gaps.explanation: 'Little did the villagers suspect' — they had no idea.

gaps.sentence: Only after the interview ___ I realise how nervous I had been.
gaps.explanation: Only after X did I realise… — inversion.

gaps.sentence: Also worth ___ is the museum's medieval wing.
gaps.explanation: Also worth noting is… — fronted comment structure.

gaps.sentence: Only later ___ we realise what he had done.
gaps.explanation: 'Only later did we realise' — inverted past simple.

gaps.sentence: At no time ___ the crew aware of the danger.
gaps.explanation: 'At no time was the crew aware' — inverted past simple of be.

gaps.sentence: So convincing ___ his argument that nobody objected.
gaps.explanation: So + adjective at the front: was his argument that…
